match_rule.note: pre-registered rule: paired formal V median within 5%, both sides reach the target, per-run E23/E20 deficit fraction difference <= 10 points, and every paired run has complete_active_windows > 0

lifecycle.scope: E2 lifecycle evidence (target replacement / first-miss) of the independently verified cases only; a local classification is never a global claim

policy.billing_vs_common_note: the policy billing window (config readback 0xe06) and the V common hardware window (raw 0xc19) are different windows and are reported separately; neither is the other's denominator
policy.permission_closed_note: raw 0xE25 is permission_closed_cycles: policy permission was closed. There is no frontend wait input, so it is never an actual ADMIT-blocked or stall period
policy.histogram_note: E40..0xE5F is the per-complete-active-window V-done histogram; bucket k counts complete active windows with k V done, bucket 31 = >=31, so sum(histogram) == complete_active_windows

conclusions.summary: all cases recovered and independently validated
notes: capability/role register matches alone never establish a mechanism
short / calibration / formal / boundary / holdout are reported separately
the run is the sample unit; the 8 formal rounds are engineering repetition only
paired differences are same-round same-target same-a_pages same-reverse, so A1 and A16 boundary data never overwrite each other
the actual (p5) method is compared against the fixed-gap control and against every other method
the protection-match decision is re-derived from the formal runs with the pre-registered rule, not from the calibration matched flag
an unmatched protection or a missing pairing never supports a protection-gain claim
holdout data is independent reverse verification and is never used to select parameters
raw 0xE25 is permission_closed_cycles, never an actual ADMIT-blocked or stall period
a malformed record and an explicitly stopped case fail closed and are preserved, never retried
raw capture is kept as-is, including on error; Linux warnings are retained but are not taint
